# Test fixtures

`premis.xsd` is the PREMIS 3.0 schema of the Library of Congress, unmodified
(<https://www.loc.gov/standards/premis/premis.xsd>; compared byte for byte on 2026-11-23). The tests validate
the PREMIS documents MES returns against it, offline. It is not part of the service and not shipped in the
image.
